comments.author: @josephg3153
comments.text:
Sadly, I somewhat predicted something like this was going to happen with third party sites.  FIFA warned everyone for months to only use their site.  There is an official resale marketplace on the FIFA site.  That is where I bought my ticket for match 9 (first match in Philadelphia) back in November 2025.

I did research on how to buy tickets for this with the plan of entering the lottery for fun.  Then I saw the link for the official resale marketplace, clicked it, and had my confirmation email from FIFA within 15 minutes.  Come match day, the ticket was in the app, it activated on time, I scanned into the stadium and had an absolute blast.

This is a situation where I don't fully blame FIFA since they were warning everyone for months.  Just people didn't know or were accustomed to habits for an event that runs on its own rules.
